content:
{'Apple TV 剛剛播完旗下熱門科幻劇集《Silo》（《末日地堡》）第三季，第四季亦即最終季已定檔明年夏天播出。': 'Apple TV has just wrapped up the third season of its hit sci-fi series Silo, with the fourth and final season slated to debut next summer.'}

{'不過呢個串流平台似乎仲有更大嘅野心。據可靠嘅 Apple TV 記者 Sigmund Judge 報導，Apple 正在籌備一套衍生劇，有望喺今年稍後時間進入前期製作階段。': 'But the streamer apparently has even bigger ambitions. According to reliable Apple TV reporter Sigmund Judge, Apple is developing a spinoff that could enter pre-production later this year.'}

{'據悉，呢套衍生劇將會改編自 Hugh Howey 即將出版嘅小說，故事圍繞地堡 40 號所發生嘅事件展開。': 'The spinoff is reportedly based on an upcoming novel by Hugh Howey, centered on events in Silo 40.'}

{'雖然 Apple 尚未證實呢個計劃，而 Howey 本人亦公開否認，但有一個細節令呢個傳聞睇落好合理：《Silo》嘅佈景至今仍未拆卸。': "While Apple hasn't confirmed the project, and Howey himself has publicly denied it, one detail makes the rumor feel credible: Silo's sets are still standing."}

{'一般嚟講，一套冇後續計劃嘅劇集（無論係自然完結定被取消）通常會好快拆景並將佈景變賣，以騰出製作場地空間作其他用途。然而 Judge 報導指，《Silo》第四季嘅拍攝已於三月結束，但至今差唔多六個月，佈景仍然屹立不倒。': 'Generally speaking, a show with no further plans — whether it ends naturally or gets cancelled — will quickly strike and sell off its sets to free up production space for other uses. Yet Judge reports that filming on Silo season 4 wrapped in March, and nearly six months later, the sets are still standing.'}

{'呢點係好有力嘅證據，顯示 Apple 計劃喺未來重用呢啲佈景，好大機會就係為目前據報籌備中嘅衍生劇所用。': "That's strong evidence Apple plans to reuse those sets in the future, most likely for the spinoff reportedly in the works."}

{'我哋已經見到 Apple 喺旗下科幻 IP 嘅衍生劇上大力投資，例如《Star City》（衍生自《For All Mankind》嘅世界觀），以及早前公布、將以「Monarch」宇宙為背景嘅新劇。': 'We\'ve already seen Apple invest heavily in spinoffs within its sci-fi IPs, such as Star City (set in the world of For All Mankind), as well as a previously announced series set in the "Monarch" universe.'}

{'而且《Silo》明顯為呢個串流平台帶來唔錯嘅收視成績，所以繼續推出相關內容都係合情合理嘅決定。': 'And Silo has clearly delivered solid viewership for the streamer, so expanding the franchise feels like a logical next step.'}
